title: Vardy 2015-16 v Shearer 1994-95: the greatest title-winning striker season?
checked: Blackburn 1994-95: Jack Walker's money, Kenny Dalglish manager, Shearer 34 league goals in 42 games, 89 points to United's 88 (Wikipedia season, Wikipedia PL). Final day 14 May 1995: Liverpool 2-1 Blackburn, Shearer scoring in the 20th minute (RSSSF, Sky); West Ham 1-1 United (Wikipedia, The National). Vardy: Stocksbridge Park Steels, Halifax, Fleetwood, Leicester 2012 for £1m (Wikipedia Vardy). Leicester bottom at Christmas 2014 and survived; 5000-1 pre-season (Wikipedia PL 2015-16, Wikipedia Leicester season). 11 games in a row, record goal v United 28 Nov 2015 from Fuchs' pass (TNT Sports, FourFourTwo). Volley v Liverpool 2 Feb 2016 from Mahrez's long ball (Leicester City, AP/Ahram). Vardy 24 league goals; Leicester 81, Arsenal 71 (Wikipedia). Each club's only Premier League title (Wikipedia list of champions). Gameplay: Vardy's record goal and volley recreated with gamecap (specs vardy-record, vardy-2016). Shearer's Anfield goal has no confirmed build-up, so no recreation.
